- Review proposed deployment topology (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink).

- Walk through networking (egress, NAT, IP ranges) and any firewall/NAT traversal you anticipate.
- Quick demo of how Redwood handles routing and fallback across regions.

Available windows next week (PST):
- Tue Jan 20: 10:00–11:30, 14:00–15:30
- Wed Jan 21: 08:30–10:00

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join (network/security/solutions) and which slot works?

Cheers,
Alex
